m: प्र-√ खाद् P. -खादति, to eat up, devour, RV.
प्र-˚खाद mfn. swallowing, devouring, ib.
प्र-खल m. a great scoundrel or villain, Mṛcch.
प्र-√ खन् (only aor. -खान्), to dig up, uproot, eradicate, Kathās.

s: puM, (prakfzwaH KaraH .) hayasannAhaH । kukkuraH । aSvataraH । atyantaKare, tri । iti medinI ॥
m: प्र-खर mfn. very hard or rough, Prasannar.
very hot or acrid, Bhām.
प्र-खर m. iron armour for the defence of a horse or elephant, L. (cf. प्रक्खर, प्र-क्षर)
a mule, L.
a dog, L.
a: प्रखर — a. 1 Very hot; as in प्रखरकिरण. --2 Very acrid or pungent, sharp. --3 Very hard or rough. --रः See प्रक्खर.

m: प्र-√ खिद् (only pr. p. -खिदत्), to thrust away, VS.
प्र-√ खुद् P. -खुदति, futuere, AV.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.

v: strI pra + KyA--BAve aN । 1 yiKyAtO 2 upamAyAM ca uttarapadasTaH vahu॰ । upamAyukte yaTA vajrapraKyaH ityAdi
m: प्र-√ ख्या P. -ख्याति, to see, RV. (Subj. -ख्यत्; inf. -ख्यै), ŚBr. (ind.p. -ख्याय); to announce, proclaim, extol, BhP. (Impv. -ख्याहि) : Pass. -ख्यायते, to be seen or known; to be visible or public or acknowledged or celebrated, Mn.; MBh. &c.: Caus. -ख्यापयति, to make generally known, proclaim, announce, publish, Mālatīm.; Rājat.
प्र-˚ख्या (आ), f. look, appearance (only ifc. = resembling, like), MBh.; R. &c.
brightness, splendour (only ifc.), R.
perceptibility, visibility, Jaim.
making manifest, disclosure, Daśar.
a: प्रख्या — {c2c} P. 1 To report, announce declare. --2 To praise, celebrate, --Pass. To be well-known or celebrated, be famous. --Caus. To celebrate proclaim, announce, declare publicly, publish.
प्रख्या — 1 Perceptibility, visibility --2 Renown, fame, celebrity; न्यवसत्परमप्रख्यः संप्रत्येब पुरीमिमां Rām. --3 Disclosure. --4 Resemblance, similitude (in comp.); Y. 3. 10. --5 Look, appearance.

m: प्र-˚ख्यानीय mfn. to be celebrated or made known, Vop.
प्र-˚ख्यान n. the being perceived or known, Pāṇ. i, 2, 54
= ˚ख्यापन, R.
a: प्रख्यानं — 1 Reporting. --2 A report, information. --3 Perception.

m: प्र-˚ख्यापनीय mfn. to be made known or published, Vop.
प्र-˚ख्यापन n. making known, report, information, R.; Daś.
a: प्रख्यापनं — 1 Publishing, making public. --2 Communicating. --3 Information.

m: प्र-˚ख्यापित mfn. known as, named (with nom.), Caṇḍ.

v: pu॰ pra + cakza--asi “bahulaM Sicca” ityukterna Sit tena KyAdeSaH । prajApatO ujjvala॰ ।

s: tri, (pra + KyA + kta .) prakfzwaKyAtiyuktaH । viKyAtaH । yaTA, -- “yasya vyAkaraRe vareRyaGawanAsPItAH prabanDA daSa praKyAtA nava vEdyake'pi tiTinirdDArArTameko'dButaH ॥” iti mugDaboDaSeze tacCizyapadam ॥
m: प्र-˚ख्यात mfn. known, celebrated, acknowledged, recognised, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
forestalled, claimed by right of pre-emption, Mn. (see below)
pleased, happy, W.
‘told (by others)’, i.e. borrowed, not original, Daśar.
a: प्रख्यात — p. p. 1 Famous, celebrated, renowned, noted. --2 Forestalled, claimed by right of pre-emption. --3 Happy, pleased. --4 Recognised, acknowledged. --Comp. --भांडं a commodity the pre-emption of which is claimed by a king. --वप्तृक a. having a celebrated father.

m: प्र-˚ख्यात—भाण्ड n. (with राज्ञः) a commodity the pre-emption of which is claimed by a king, Mn. viii, 399
प्र-˚ख्यात—बल-वीर्य mfn. of celebrated strength and valour, R.
प्र-˚ख्यात—सद्-भर्तृ m. known as a good husband, Kathās.

s: puM, (praKyAto vaptA janayitA yasya । kap .) viKyAtapitfkaH । yaTA, -- “syAdAmuzyAyaRo'muzya puttraH praKyAtavaptfkaH ॥” iti hemacandraH । 3 । 166 ॥
v: pu॰ praKyAto vaptA janayitA yasya kap । viKyAtapitfke amuzyaputre hemaca॰ ।
m: प्र-˚ख्यात—वप्तृक mfn. having a celebrated father, L.
प्र-˚ख्याति f. visibility, perceptibility, celebrity (only अ-प्रख्˚), MBh.
praise, eulogium, W.
a: प्रख्यातिः — f. 1 Fame, renown, celebrity. --2 Praise, eulogium. --3 Perceptibility.

m: प्र-˚ख्यायमान mfn. being celebrated or spoken about, Nal.

s: tri, (praKyAtIti । pra + KyA KyAtO + kaH .) uttarapade tulyArTavAcakaH yaTA, -- “syuruttarapade praKyaH prakAraH pratimo niBaH ॥” iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 208 । 31 । “dvipakzagaruqapraKyErdvArEH sODESca SoBitam । guptamaBracayapraKyErgopurErmmandaropamEH ॥” SrezWaH । yaTA, tatrEva । 12 । 204 । 8 । “jYAnamutpadyate puMsAM kzayAt pApasya karmmaRaH । yaTAdarSatale praKye paSyatyAtmAnamAtmani ॥”)
m: प्र-˚ख्य mfn. visible, clear, bright, ŚBr.; MBh.
a: प्रख्य — a. 1 Clear, visible, distinct. --2 Looking like, resembling (at the end of comp.); अमृत˚, शशांक˚ &c.

m: प्र-˚ख्यस् m. = प्रजा-पति, Uṇ. iv, 232, Sch.
the planet Jupiter, L.
